input.new_string:
because they execute only on a release, so a PR's checks cannot exercise them. E2 delegation floor relaxed: three-file sed-level edit fully in-context; an infra-ops agent would only add latency.
- 2026-11-03: Force renew bypasses the staged-expiry design (ISC-181..203). Trigger: Nick reported that today's force renew for an SMLSC member did not send her fob for an expiry update. Evidence: one `POST .../force-renew` at 00:28Z returned 200 (the only one in 30 days); `force-renew/route.ts` is untouched since 31 Mar 2026, before the 8 Apr change that made renewal stage `pendingExpiresAt` + `programmingRequired` for the programmer. It still writes `expiresAt` directly on `active` fobs (AccessBuddy then shows a date the door system never received) and skips `expired` fobs entirely, so nothing ever reaches `/admin` credential updates, whose only filter is `programmingRequired`. The 2026-09-04 decision already recorded "force-renew skips already-expired fobs" as a known gap; it was never actioned. Fix: force renew now does what the member's "yes" does, for `active` and `expired` fobs (the attestation GET's own filter), skipping a fob already at the target expiry so a renewal that was already programmed does not re-queue. Rejected: refusing force renew when a fob is already staged (idempotent re-run is the remediation path for the affected member). Delegation floor (E3 soft ≥2) relaxed to one: Forge needs the codex CLI, absent on this box (recorded gotcha); the route is one function fully read in-context; `accessbuddy-qa-verify` runs the independent gate. ISC count 23 < soft floor 32: a single route plus labels and copy; more criteria would be manufactured.

## Why

Today's Force Renew on an SMLSC member (3 Nov, 11:28 AEDT) returned 200 but her fob never reached the programmer. `force-renew/route.ts` dates from 31 Mar, before renewal moved to the staged-expiry model on 8 Apr, and was never migrated: it wrote `expiresAt` straight onto ACTIVE fobs (AccessBuddy then shows a date the access system never received) and skipped EXPIRED fobs entirely. Nothing it did could put a fob on the `/admin` credential updates list, whose only filter is `programmingRequired`. The 4 Sep review (defect 2, `context/state.md` item 8) had already recorded this; this PR actions it.

## What

- Force Renew now does what the member's "yes" on the confirmation page does, for `active` and `expired` fobs: stages `pendingExpiresAt` (season end, falling forward if the chosen season has rolled over, same rule as a scoped confirmation), sets `programmingRequired`, a reason naming the fob and the admin's reason, `programmingRequestedAt`. The live `expiresAt` is never written; confirm-programming promotes it and reactivates an expired fob exactly as it does after an attestation.
- Skips a fob already at the target expiry with nothing pending (already programmed) and a fob already staged for the same date; an already-flagged fob keeps the reason the programmer is reading and only has its staged date moved. A second Force Renew for the same season is a no-op on credentials.
- Completes every pending attestation for the member (unscoped and scoped) with the in-scope staged fobs recorded as confirmed, guarded on `status = pending`.
- Response carries `staged`, `skipped` and `pendingExpiresAt`; the form says "N fobs sent to the programmer for an expiry update" (or why nothing was). Form copy no longer promises an immediate renewal of credentials.
- Audit labels for `force_renew` and `force_renew_expiry_update` in both renderers. Rows written by the old route (no `pendingExpiresAt`) render as "expiry rewritten directly (no programming update staged)" so they can be found.
- Tests: `force-renew.test.ts` (DB-gated, 9 cases: expired staged, active staged, already-at-target skipped, already-flagged keeps reason, idempotent re-run, other statuses untouched, staff untouched, attestations completed, hand-off to confirm-programming with one `credentialReactivated` email) and label assertions.

## Gates

typecheck 5/5, lint 0 errors, tests shared 27 / db 16 / web 377 with the DB-gated suites running (0 skipped) on the embedded Postgres.

## After merge

Re-run Force Renew on the affected member: her fob is `expired`, so the new route stages it and it appears on `/admin` credential updates. Members whose active fobs were force-renewed by the old route before 1 Sep (if any) now look "already programmed" to the skip rule; find them with the `force_renew_expiry_update` audit rows that carry `newExpiresAt` but no `pendingExpiresAt` and flag them by hand.

-- Force renew probe, 3 Nov 2026. Read-only. Run inside a prod DB window
-- (audit_log is FORCE RLS, so the tenant must be set first).
--
-- Q1: the member force-renewed today (ffa19098-...): fob state and whether
--     anything is staged for the programmer.
-- Q2: every force_renew_expiry_update row ever written by the OLD route
--     (it rewrote the live expiry: metadata has newExpiresAt and no
--     pendingExpiresAt). Each such ACTIVE fob was never programmed and the
--     new route's skip rule will leave it alone; flag those by hand.
-- Q3: all force_renew member events, to size the blast radius.

SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant_id',
  (SELECT id::text FROM tenants WHERE slug = 'south-melb-lsc'), false);

-- Q1
SELECT c.id, c.serial_number, c.status, c.expires_at, c.pending_expires_at,
       c.programming_required, c.programming_reason, c.programming_requested_at
FROM credentials c
WHERE c.owner_id = 'ffa19098-64b5-4802-95a2-3137ce1ee3e0'
ORDER BY c.status, c.serial_number;

SELECT a.id, a.season, a.status, a.credential_ids, a.created_at, a.completed_at
FROM attestation_requests a
WHERE a.user_id = 'ffa19098-64b5-4802-95a2-3137ce1ee3e0'
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;

-- Q2
SELECT al.created_at, al.entity_id AS credential_id, c.serial_number, c.status,
       c.expires_at, c.programming_required,
       al.metadata->>'season' AS season,
       al.metadata->>'newExpiresAt' AS rewritten_to,
       u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS owner
FROM audit_log al
JOIN credentials c ON c.id = al.entity_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.owner_id
WHERE al.entity_type = 'credential'
  AND al.metadata->>'action' = 'force_renew_expiry_update'
  AND al.metadata->>'pendingExpiresAt' IS NULL
ORDER BY al.created_at;

-- Q3
SELECT al.created_at, al.entity_id AS user_id,
       u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS member,
       al.metadata->>'season' AS season, al.metadata->>'reason' AS reason
FROM audit_log al
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = al.entity_id
WHERE al.entity_type = 'member'
  AND al.metadata->>'action' = 'force_renew'
ORDER BY al.created_at;

Force Renew (`members/[id]/force-renew/route.ts`) dated from 31 Mar 2026 and was never migrated to the 8 Apr staged-expiry model: it wrote `expiresAt` straight onto ACTIVE fobs and ignored EXPIRED ones, so nothing ever set `programmingRequired`, the only filter on `/admin` credential updates. Trigger: Nick, 3 Nov 2026, "Force renew was done today for Christine Cardwell, but her fob was not sent for expiry update". Prod logs: one force-renew POST 00:28Z, the only one in 30 days. The 4 Sep Dinah Boswell review had already recorded the defect (state.md item 8) and three members force-renewed 2-3 Sep; it sat unactioned.

Fix on branch `fix/force-renew-stages-expiry-update` (895a8ae), PR https://github.com/nicholas-wood/accessbuddy/pull/125, ISC-181..203 in the project ISA: stages `pendingExpiresAt` + `programmingRequired` for active and expired fobs via `scopedAttestationExpiry`, skips a fob already at the target or already staged for it, keeps the reason on an already-flagged fob, completes every pending attestation (guarded on `pending`), returns `staged`/`skipped`, labels in both audit renderers, form copy fixed. DB-gated `force-renew.test.ts` (9 cases).

**Why:** the programmer only sees the staged flag; a direct expiry write leaves AccessBuddy claiming a date the door system never got.

**How to apply:**
- Merge is Nick's. After release, re-run Force Renew on the member (her fob is `expired`, so the old code did nothing to it) and probe `/admin` with Interceptor (ISC-202).
- Pre-release workaround that needs no deploy: Add Credential → her expired fob under "This member's previous fobs" → expiry-update stage → "Member confirmed in person" stages it immediately.
- Old-route rows: `force_renew_expiry_update` audit rows with `newExpiresAt` and no `pendingExpiresAt` mark active fobs that were rewritten but never programmed; the new skip rule leaves them alone. Probe SQL at `projects/accessbuddy/artifacts/sql/2026-11-03-force-renew-probe.sql` (Q2) for Nick's DB window.
- Embedded test Postgres: `/tmp/ab-pg-scratch` was wiped by tmp cleanup while its server kept running on an empty data dir (tests "pass" with every DB suite skipped). Rebuilt at `~/.claude/jobs/2e24043d/tmp/ab-pg/run.ts` (`bun add embedded-postgres@17.5.0-beta.15`, then `bun pm trust --all` or initdb exits 127). Always check "0 skipped" and that `ss -ltn | grep 54329` is backed by a live data dir. See [[project-accessbuddy-pr111-expiry-update-stage]].
- Refactor still owed: attestation yes-path, confirm-on-behalf, manual stage and force-renew each inline the same staging block; a shared `stageExpiryUpdate(tx, …)` helper would have prevented this class of drift (RCA root cause).
